answer: Require influence to be earned through jobs attested by unrelated established peers, with each job recorded on a public ledger. A newcomer starts with no history, so a fable of instant trust earns nothing: it must accumulate verified work step by step, like a spiral that widens only as outside peers confirm each turn. Accounts that copy another history are held apart until separate peers vouch for them, and a plume of fresh, unproven identities gains no weight until each one proves real work. Spawning fakes then multiplies slow cost without multiplying power.
